notes: Adds live visibility into whether the Free Service Gateway is currently under attack: a 'Gateway requests (last minute)' card at the top of the Dashboard (with a clear Normal / Possible attack status), plus a compact version in the header next to CPU/RAM, both refreshing every 30 seconds. Status is based on how many requests were rejected/blocked in the last minute, not raw traffic volume. Only visible to admins with Free Service Gateway or Security access. No database update needed for this update.
